question: Can a fixed pretrained EEG encoder and a fixed single-token classifier mapping yield a useful observed-action decoder on the existing enriched cohort?

simultaneous_changes: pretrained frozen EEG encoder replaces trainable CNN
single-token restricted next-token CE replaces variable-length candidate-sequence likelihood

input.position: final second inside fixed pre-action window
input.resample: scipy.signal.resample_poly up25/down32 on extracted last256 samples, default zero padding

labels.training_objective: unweighted cross entropy of exactly the three next-token vocabulary logits
labels.inference: softmax over those same three logits, one forward pass, no candidate answer or EOS tokens supplied

capacity_selection.rule: largest completed within-budget candidate with at least50 steps, at least one train epoch equivalent, and stable last10 allocator readings

training.init: fresh fixed seed; no capacity-probe projector reuse
training.best_checkpoint: validation balanced accuracy, earliest checkpoint wins ties
training.time_scope: loop and validation elapsed; an in-flight step/final validation can finish after stop is observed; actual time recorded
training.resume_time_budget: cumulative saved elapsed, not a fresh900 seconds

evaluation.context_only: zero EEG input through fixed encoder; distribution-shift input-removal ablation
evaluation.eeg_only: remove environment text, preserve fixed mapping instruction
evaluation.time_shift: actual raw EEG10 seconds earlier, independently verify source and original prepared array
evaluation.primary_classification: forced three-class balanced accuracy plus complete confusion matrix
evaluation.observed_request_binary: A probability threshold0.5, AUROC, AP, participant bootstrap; existing history score-predictions, no new model inference

m1_trial.selection: first sorted ID per recorded class
m1_trial.checkpoint: same L4 validation-selected best, after five-condition evaluation receipt
m1_trial.actions: dry-run router only, OS0, cloud agent0

execution_preconditions: new controller gate has a live tick
previous Qwen workflow evaluation is complete and GPU is idle
source, protocol, official EEG weights, immutable Smol revision and prepared arrays match
public files and prior run/checkpoints remain unchanged
